text:
emma_sales: Looping folks on AtlasScale co-sell POC. Partner asks: 10-day private-tenant trial, SSQ answers, short reserved pricing for a small dedicated pool, and an enablement session for SSO + telemetry.

leo_se: AtlasScale legal attached an SSQ and wants VPC peering for eu-west data residency. Theyre open to redwood-managed KMS for pilot but require BYOK/HSM in prod. They also want a sample incident response timeline.

priya_privsec: I can do SSQ. Need their VPC CIDRs, IdP metadata, and whether they expect audit logs shipped to their SIEM (they mentioned Splunk). For pilot: redacted SOC2 + one-page controls matrix available. Data deletion SLA: default 48h for ephemeral logs; metrics 30d unless they request extended retention.

noah_ops: Ops can provision a constrained private-tenant for 10 calendar days if they sign the pilot addendum and prepay baseline capacity. We'll cap GPUs and egress; tenant will be single-AZ and not SLA-backed. Need peering method: VPC peering vs PrivateLink.

leo_se: Perf ask from AtlasScale: sustained 70 rps at 400 tokens, target ~0.19s/token median. With KV cache and modest batching that should be okay on a small reserved pool. Ballpark reserved cost: $28k-$42k/mo depending on region and GPU SKU.

emma_sales: They want a no-commit short trial to unblock procurement. Can we provide templates for SAML metadata and SCIM endpoints so they can set up SSO today?

deploy-bot: SAML metadata sample:
```
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://redwood.example/saml">
  <!-- ACS URL: https://console.redwood/saml/acs -->
  <!-- X509 cert here -->
</EntityDescriptor>
```
SCIM basics: POST /scim/v2/Users Authorization: Bearer <token>. PATCH supported for groups.

priya_privsec: I'll bundle SOC2 redacted, incident response timeline (RTO/RPO summary), and the controls matrix. Also ask AtlasScale if they want SIEM forwarding during the trial and for the Splunk HEC endpoint + token if so.

noah_ops: Ops action items: 1) collect AtlasScale CIDRs and peering choice, 2) provision trial tenant after prepay, 3) publish egress IPs and teardown schedule. We'll require prepayment of $2.8k for the trial.

leo_se: Engineering action: I'll prepare a short perf-runbook (load phases, KV warmup, autoscale expectations) and a quick sim to validate the 70 rps at 400 tokens target. Will post numbers tomorrow.

emma_sales: Great. Action list: 1) Priya = SSQ + SOC2 + IR timeline, 2) Noah = tenant provisioning + prepay instr, 3) Leo = perf runbook + sim, 4) Emma = coordinate legal and schedule enablement.

priya_privsec: One more compliance note: AtlasScale asked for a sample pen-test summary. We can provide a redacted pen-test findings summary and a short note on our patching cadence.

emma_sales: Perfect. I'll request IdP metadata and confirm Splunk details with AtlasScale. Tentatively scheduling a 45-min enablement next Thu to walk SAML/SCIM and telemetry once metadata is in. Thanks team. :raised_hands:

noah_ops: Noted. I'll draft the pilot addendum and the teardown/runbook and post here when ready.

leo_se: I'll also include a cost sensitivity table (cache hit rate vs node count) so procurement can see trade-offs.

emma_sales: Closing for now; will update the thread with quote, SSQ draft, and enablement invite.
